evidence: UNVERIFIED: Pantai Tanjung Kartika is promoted as a nature destination (being eroded by limestone mining) but no source found on sand type or swimming - https://katadata.co.id/ekonomi-hijau/investasi-hijau/6a155c8556ff4/menelisik-pantai-kartika-raja-ampat-kecil-sultra-yang-digerus-tambang-kapur
UNVERIFIED: Pantai Berova (Desa Pitulua) studied as a tourism site but no source on sand or swimming - https://journal3.uin-alauddin.ac.id/index.php/planomadani/article/download/36491/17004

Pulau Sara (15-20 min by speedboat from Melonguane) has fine white sand and clear water; described as pleasant and safe for swimming, even for children, with no dangerous waves or currents - https://www.kompas.tv/regional/294648/pesona-pulau-sara-dari-perbatasan-utara-nkri

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Tanjung Waka (Desa Fatkauyon, Kec. Sulabesi Timur) has a white sand beach but no source describes swimming there - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/2021/12/10/menjelajah-kepulauan-sula-sambil-menyaksikan-festival-tanjung-waka-2021
UNVERIFIED: no source found on Pantai Tanganga; Temboko Lehi hot-water beach is rocky; no Sitaro sand beach with swimming evidence found - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temboko_Lehi_Beach

Pantai Pinang (Desa Bontoborusu, Kec. Bontoharu, Selayar) has clean white sand and tourists swim there; clear water also suited to snorkeling; best Nov-Apr - https://djpb.kemenkeu.go.id/kppn/benteng/id/data-publikasi/berita-terbaru/2839-pantai-pinang-selayar-surga-eksotis-yang-masih-tersembunyi.html

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Jati (Desa Tuapejat, Kec. Sipora Utara) described as very calm waves with white sand and clear water, but no source explicitly describes swimming there - https://jurnal.unimed.ac.id/2012/index.php/ph/article/view/28093
UNVERIFIED: no source found on Pantai Papaliseran or Pantai Pasir Karunia sand/swimming - https://www.kupi.com/en/explore/indonesia/dobo

Anambas travel feature: Pulau Elang white sand is very soft and the best way to enjoy it is to sit or swim at the water's edge (Padang Melang only described as clean sand/clear water) - https://mongabay.co.id/2016/12/25/mongabay-travel-keajaiban-laut-itu-ada-di-anambas/amp/

Pantai Linau, first beach entering Kaur from Kota Bengkulu; visitors can swim safely because waves are not too big (sand described as white by some sources, black by Traveloka) - https://www.detik.com/sumbagsel/wisata/d-7227999/9-wisata-alam-di-kabupaten-kaur-cocok-untuk-healing-bareng-keluarga-nih

Pantai Hermun in Teluk Triton (Kaimana): very white sand, turquoise sea; members of the visiting group swam in the sea there - https://kumparan.com/balleonews/keindahan-teluk-triton-kaimana-dijuluki-the-lost-paradise-201eFu1Q83R

Pantai Minanga (Kec. Atinggola): white sand strip, calm waters; site of the mandi Safar sea-bathing tradition (no explicit recreational-swimming statement) - https://ejurnal.ung.ac.id/index.php/jrpi/article/download/39584/13581

Jikumerasa (Paserputih) white sand beach on west coast of Buru; study states no dangerous biota on west Buru coast so the area is safe for swimming - https://journal.uinsgd.ac.id/index.php/jispo/article/download/6206/3735

UNVERIFIED: Tanjung Dako only described as a marine tourism area under DED planning; no source on sand or swimming - https://rri.co.id/toli-toli/regional/2567349/potensi-wisata-bahari-buol-menjanjikan-ded-tanjung-dako-disiapkan

Pantai Botutonuo (Kec. Kabila Bone) frequently visited by local and foreign tourists for swimming; land suitability for swimming rated very suitable (81%) (sand colour not stated in snippet) - https://ejurnal.ung.ac.id/index.php/nike/article/view/1226
UNVERIFIED: no web source found on Pulau Molosing sand or swimming - https://www.expedia.co.id/North-Sulawesi.dx3000652274

Pantai Bolihutuo (Kec. Botumoito, Boalemo): clean soft white sand, gently sloping seabed, calm water in mornings facing Teluk Tomini; visitors swim, snorkel and dive - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/indonesiana/wisata/pantai-bolihutuo-hidden-gem-gorontalo

UNVERIFIED: no source on Pantai Muara Ketahun; Pantai Pasar Palik study notes high abrasion and shore-parallel currents but no swimming assessment - https://proceedings.ums.ac.id/siar/article/download/1711/1670/1676

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Sejarah (Desa Perupuk, Kec. Lima Puluh Pesisir) described with white sand and cafes but no source on swimming - https://steemit.steemapps.com/hive-111293/@taca/the-beach-has-a-history-or-memories-of-historical-beach-charm

Swimming-suitability study of Pantai Tanjung Langka (Kel. Padang Mulia, Bangka Tengah) rates it S3 conditionally suitable for swimming (needs public toilets), carrying capacity 624 people/day; sand type not stated in snippet - https://journal.ubb.ac.id/index.php/aquaticscience/article/download/5360/2493/16762
